Pax World Management Llc decreased its stake in Disney Walt Co (DIS) by 7.51% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pax World Management Llc sold 15,292 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 188,323 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $18.92 million, down from 203,615 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pax World Management Llc who had been investing in Disney Walt Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $162.24 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.09% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $108.85. About 16.17 million shares traded or 88.31% up from the average.
